messages:
maria (product): MercuryPay reported a throughput/latency regression post-rollout. p95 jumped for long prompts. raising triage. @liam @noah please advise.

zara (support): SUP-4982. Spike started 2025-11-18T04:15Z after deploy-bot finished. Dedicated tenant, qps~180, prompts ~1k tokens. p95 200ms->670ms.

deploy-bot: rollout v2.8 (model/omega-70b-quant) completed at 2025-11-18T04:12:02Z :package: 

liam (eng-runtime): grabbing traces. Are they using KV prefix caching and batching disabled?

zara (support): yes to caching, batching off. They do convo-history.

noah (eng-platform): Quick mitigations: tenant rollback, route to q4f variant, or apply sequence-chop transform. Rollback fastest.

eva (sales): MercuryPay is enterprise; they expect mitigation within 12h and regular updates.

liam (eng-runtime): I see a kernel path change in v2.8 that bypasses fused-KV for seq>512 when convo_history present. Repro locally with 1k tokens.

maria (product): Proposal: 1) Tenant override to v2.7 for MercuryPay now. 2) Open PROD-6610: Investigate v2.8 KV/attention ordering. Acceptance: reproduce, CI regression test, automated fallback, runbook + comms. P1. Mitigation ETA 30-45m. RCA target 72h.

noah (eng-platform): Applying tenant override now. rule id route-8842. deployed.

deploy-bot: applied route override route-8842 at 2025-11-18T04:38:10Z :white_check_mark: 

liam (eng-runtime): After override replay shows p95 back to ~230ms. I'll own PROD-6610.

maria (product): Thanks. Sales, support, and eng-platform to notify customer and monitor. We'll reconvene after RCA.
